title: Electricity from a concentration difference
promptMarkdown: Two ideal Cu²⁺/Cu half cells at 298.15 K have activities 0.200 and 0.00200. Treat liquid-junction contributions as negligible. Which side is reduced? Derive the spontaneous overall transfer and calculate its open-circuit voltage. Predict the effect of dividing both activities by ten and then of making the ratio one. Explain why this is not a source of unlimited energy.
hintLadder: Write Ered for each half cell separately.
Subtract and cancel the standard potential.
Track which solution gains Cu²⁺ during operation.
